"What will we talk about?"

It is up to you - I am happy talking about anything!

"What do you mean 'feedback and corrections'?"

“How is this course different from your other courses?”

My other courses are more traditional English lessons, with exercises, grammar explanations, tests and so on. .

The main focus of the conversation sessions is to build your confidence speaking English: you already have a lot of knowledge and I am here to help you build the confidence to use what you know. Practice makes perfect!

pro_course_detail.title: Read with/to me and writing improvement
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is to help you build your confidence with reading.
If you are currently reading a book in English and are unsure of your pronunciation, or you are not sure that you understand everything that is going on, I can help! In short, you will read, and I will systematically correct pronunciation errors. After we have finished a page, I will check your understanding of what you have just read and explain to the best of my ability anything that you have not understood. This technique is called "intensive reading" in the language community and coupled with "extensive reading" is a great way to expand your vocabulary.

Alternatively:
I will send you a short news article that you can read aloud to me. Then I will correct any pronunciation mistakes that you may have made, and finally, I will ask you some comprehension questions about the article to ensure that you have understood everything that has taken place.

Writing: I will send you a prompt before the lesson, and you will then have to write about the prompt in as much detail as you can muster (Usually aiming for around 200 - 300 words). Once the lesson begins, you will be able to read what you have written and we will then go over it together. Here we will fix any problems that we come across, such as word order, incorrect word usage, spelling errors, etc. I will also suggest possible vocab based on what you have written.
